title: Reported comments
lead: Open reports, newest first: hide the comment here, or hide and resolve in one step; dismiss reports that need no action. Tick several to settle them at once.
settleFailed: Could not update the reports. They may be settled already; reload.
hiddenResolved: Comment hidden and its reports resolved.

all.title: All comments
all.lead: Every comment on the site, newest first. Search by text or author, then hide or show one or many.

bulk.label: Selected comments
bulk.count: {count} comments selected | {count} comment selected | {count} comments selected

refused.parentHidden: Its parent is hidden: show the parent first.
refused.gone: Gone or out of your reach.

result.resolved: {done} resolved, {refused} refused (already settled or out of reach).
result.dismissed: {done} dismissed, {refused} refused (already settled or out of reach).

edit.title: Edit the comment
edit.label: Comment text (Markdown)
edit.hint: Saved as a new version: the author and moderators see the history.
edit.loadFailed: Could not load the comment. It may be deleted or out of your reach.

locks.title: Locked comment pages
locks.lead: Pages where nobody but lock overriders can post comments, newest lock first. Unlock a page to open its discussion again.
locks.empty: No page has its comments locked.
